release_notes: v9.8.24 — (1) Bumped cloud-upload timeout from 30s to 120s so large FY sync uploads (4000+ vouchers) no longer drop on slow connections. (2) Improved AlterID detection: now tries TDL system functions first ($$LastAlterIdMaster + $$LastAlterIdVouchers) and falls back to a direct MAX($AlterID/$Alterid) over the Voucher and Ledger collections — restoring true incremental sync on Tally Prime 7.0. (3) End-of-cycle structured summary is now posted to the cloud so the web Sync History page can show an 'Incomplete' badge instead of silently dropping types when a phase fails.
